specs.title: Scaffold product repo
specs.why: Nothing else can be built until the app skeleton, database client and CI entry points exist.
specs.scope: Create a Next.js 14 (App Router) + TypeScript + Tailwind + Prisma + Postgres application in this repository. Add `.env.example`, a `/api/health` route, and baseline lint/format config (ESLint, Prettier).
specs.non_goals: Do not modify anything under `.github/` — CI and agent workflows are managed centrally and changing them mid-run breaks the pipeline that is running you.
tasks: Initialize Next.js app with TypeScript and Tailwind
Add Prisma with Postgres provider and empty schema

specs.title: Database schema v1
specs.why: Every later feature reads or writes these tables, so the model must land before feature work.
specs.scope: Define Prisma models for `Tenant`, `User`, `Service`, `Staff`, `BusinessHour`, `Client`, `Booking`, `Payment`, `AuditLog`. All tenant-owned rows carry `tenantId` with an index. Add a seed script creating one demo tenant with sample services.
tasks: Write Prisma models with relations and indexes
Write `prisma/seed.ts` with a demo tenant and 3 services
acceptance: `prisma db seed` inserts the demo tenant
